content:
Apple's most anticipated product launch event of the year is about to take place, with more than 10 new products expected to be unveiled. The following are the five brand-new Apple products I'm most looking forward to.

iPhone Ultra

The first foldable iPhone is about to launch, combining the iPhone and iPad mini into one — truly exciting.

Although numerous hardware specifications have already leaked, it's the software of the iPhone Ultra that holds the key to the entire user experience. Therefore, I'm very eager to see how Apple adapts iOS 27 to run more naturally and powerfully on a foldable screen.

I've never tried a foldable smartphone, but based on everything I've read, this type of form factor design will be the future trend. Apple has clearly given much thought before entering the foldable market, and I have very high expectations, believing it will be worth the wait.

HomePad

For years, I've been hoping Apple would take the smart home market seriously. When Mark Gurman first detailed the upcoming 'HomePad' at the end of 2024, it signalled that this transformation was imminent.

Everything about HomePad excites me. The Apple Photos slideshow feature, security camera functions, Siri AI, Apple Music playback with lyrics display — all of these features make me eager to give them a try.

The delay of Siri AI has made the wait for HomePad much longer than expected. But all signs point to an imminent launch, and I'm ready to witness Apple leading the way into a new era of smart home through HomePad and other new Home products.

Next-generation Apple TV 4K

It's been four years since the last Apple TV 4K was released. The product certainly doesn't need updating every year, but the rise of AI has brought many possibilities for a comprehensive experience overhaul.

I'm very excited to see how Siri AI, a more powerful processor, and other hardware and software upgrades come together to make this Apple TV upgrade worthwhile.

With the next-generation Apple TV 4K launching alongside the camera-equipped HomePad, I'm also curious whether earlier rumours about a built-in camera will finally come true. Being able to use FaceTime on a big screen without relying on an iPhone in the future would certainly be very convenient.

MacBook Ultra

I've been using the iPad Pro as my primary computer for over a decade. When I switched to iPad back in 2015, it was because Macs had been falling behind the iPad in terms of both hardware and software innovation.

The arrival of Apple Silicon on Macs solved some of the problems. macOS is also increasingly being updated in sync with iOS and iPadOS. But many aspects of the Mac remain stuck in the past rather than looking to the future.

I believe the MacBook Ultra will change that. The addition of touch functionality, OLED display, Dynamic Island, a completely refreshed design, and even possible cellular connectivity — each is extremely appealing. This is the Mac update I've been waiting for, and I can't wait to see what surprises Apple has in store.

Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4

I haven't decided yet whether to go for the Series 12 or Ultra 4 this year. Either way, I'm very excited about the new models, because there's one key upgrade rumoured: a brand-new design and an S-series chip built specifically for the AI era.

Apple Watch chips don't get updated often. While Apple tweaks the S-series chip almost every year, meaningful CPU performance improvements only come around roughly every three years. Therefore, there hasn't been a major leap since the S9 in 2023.

But there are rumours that this year's new Apple Watch models will feature a more powerful brand-new chip — the first chip designed specifically for the AI era — which couldn't be better timed with the launch of Siri AI.

Which upcoming Apple product are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
